text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I was getting ready for the training camp,
Speed Symboli called out to me—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun.
You've been producing remarkable results lately.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
All the more reason why...
I want you all to push even further ahead.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"To challenge what no one has ever achieved
requires an equal measure of resolve and dedication."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Unceasing diligence—toward the horizon you girls aim for...
If anything I possess could serve as thrust for you.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be of help in your challenge.
—Please, take my heart along with you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Guided by Speed Symboli...
<chrname> gained invaluable insight!
